items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: I heard him do a radio broadcast with his band. And it was an unbelievable band. They were so hot I still get goose pimples talking about this band 60 years ago, 65 years ago. I says I’ve got to buy the clarinet.

ctx.x: Okay then I was 14. I heard him do a radio broadcast with his band. And it was an unbelievable band. They were so hot I still get goose pimples talking about this band 60 years ago, 65 years ago. I says I’ve got to buy the clarinet. I didn’t know if I was going to be a professional or what. Thank God that’s all I’ve been doing all my life. I’ve been very fortunate. I wish my wife was here. I just lost my wife a few years ago. We were married for 51 glorious years.
